reasoning: On the season so far the Mavericks are the stronger team; with home court the Mavericks start about 1 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Jazz.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Mavericks win 51 times in 100; most games like this end between 201 and 249 total points.

analyst.text: Dallas beat the Clippers on Saturday behind Kyrie Irving's 25, so this is the second night of a back-to-back at altitude to open a three-game trip, and P.J. Washington missed Saturday ill. Utah are on a long losing run with Lauri Markkanen (hand) and Jaren Jackson Jr. (MCL) out for weeks. Fatigue narrows the gap, but the angle still leans towards Dallas.
